content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common, and a lot of toddlers are still doing it. Tonight, try a short, boring check-in when he wakes. Go in, put a hand on his back, and say one calm line like "night night, I'm here". Keep the lights off and skip the pickup, then leave while he's still a little awake. Do the same thing every time so he learns that waking up isn't a party.
